title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned the painted bicycle frame. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Cat Rangka
options.lineage: painted bicycle frames — enamel panels, decal bands and racing stripes printed along steel tubing
options.thesis: The frame's own paint job carries the page: one printed band you read the whole way down.
options.viewport: A rotated ivory tube crossing an enamel-green ground, the offer and the search set on it.
options.risk: A decorated ground reads as decoration unless the search sits inside the printing.

raised.raise: Charged emptiness: the ground is not padding — the empty enamel above the band is placed off-centre and holds the eye.
Time as one continuous band: the chosen block is lit and printed, the hours around it fall back into shadow.
One graphic vocabulary reused across the whole set, so the four categories read as one signed system, not four chips.

options.label: Jadwal Hari
options.lineage: printed bus and ferry timetables — one day ruled into banded hour columns
options.thesis: One day, one grid: every outlet's stock printed under the hour bands it belongs to.
options.viewport: A ruled outlet × time-band grid, the chosen cell double-outlined, the action naming the outlet.
options.risk: The printed timetable is the most familiar way this category shows stock, so it reads as a plain table if the ruling is not exact.

options.label: Poster Solidaritas
options.lineage: OSPAAAL solidarity silkscreens — flat fearless fields, one saturated ink pass for the emblem, the slogan repeated as a border
options.thesis: The offer printed as one flat poster: the bicycle emblem in focus, the promise running around it as a set border.
options.viewport: A hot-red emblem plate on a cream sheet inside a repeating slogan border, the action boxed in ink.
options.case: Fuses with force: flat fields give the numbers a poster's certainty and the border turns the promise into structure — but a solidarity poster argues where a rental errand only needs to confirm.
options.risk: The poster's rhetoric is louder than the errand; urgency is added, not found.

options.label: Penghitung Nixie
options.lineage: nixie-tube laboratory counters — stacked metal numerals glowing orange inside glass envelopes on blackened steel
options.thesis: Stock as glowing digits: each outlet's count lit inside its own tube, the dark digit the honest zero.
options.viewport: A large master digit bank over five outlet banks, each unlit leading zero dim in its glass.
options.case: Fuses hard: the count is literally the interface, and an unlit digit is the clearest zero in the whole hand — but a lab counter is an instrument, not a shopfront, and a few hours on a bike is not a measurement.
options.risk: An instrument's precision reads cold for an errand that should feel easy.

options.label: Rel Emisi
options.lineage: spectroscopic emission-line plates — hairline wavelengths on a banded charcoal continuum, state carried in line form
options.thesis: Every outlet a hairline standing on one off-centre rail, the open one blooming into a plate above it.
materials: one grotesque at a single size
options.viewport: One off-centre rail with five vertical stubs, the open outlet's plate above and a lit line marking today's stock.
options.case: Fuses precisely: availability as line form rather than colour is the strongest state language in the hand, and one rail carries legend, navigation and state at once — but it is an instrument's grammar, and a renter in a hurry may not find the button inside it.
options.risk: State-as-line-form is elegant but must be learned before it can be read.

options.label: Plat Kolektif
options.lineage: signed collective plates — a shared symbol set in hard-edged flat colour, each work signed with an invented mark
options.thesis: Every category a plate from the same symbol set, each one signed.
options.viewport: Hard-edged symbols hover over a flat ground, one corner reserved for a signature.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a shared-symbol art plate is an exercise in attribution, and someone choosing a bike in Jambi does not identify with it.
options.risk: Reads as an exhibition wall, not a shopfront.
options.kept: One graphic vocabulary reused across every work, so a whole set reads as one signed system.

options.label: Potongan Cahaya
options.lineage: daylight sections — a sunbeam crossing a building, the hours read along its moving edge
options.thesis: The day as one continuous section with the useful hours lit.
options.viewport: A ruled section with the active hour band lit gold and withdrawn hours in shadow blue.
options.case: Fuses poorly: the instrument is exact, but the renter's question is a bike, not daylight.
options.risk: A beautiful measurement of the wrong thing.
options.kept: Time as one continuous band — the chosen hours lit, the withdrawn hours falling back into shadow.

options.label: Ma Ikebana
options.lineage: tokonoma alcove arrangements — asymmetric lines over charged empty plaster
options.thesis: The offer arranged off-centre, the emptiness part of the composition.
options.viewport: A few vertical lines set off-centre with the plaster around them left charged.
options.case: Fuses poorly: the discipline is real, but a Japanese alcove is a world Jambi's renters never knew.
options.risk: Empty space must be earned by the product, not borrowed from another culture.
options.kept: Charged emptiness — whitespace given a job, an asymmetric balance that keeps the eye moving.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The rental marketplace landing page this category ships, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: A photographed hero over a search bar and a grid of equal outlet cards.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
